title: Fuzzy Uniform Topology on a PUP-Algebra
content:
This paper introduces the concept of extreme fuzzy PUP ideals within the framework of a
 PUP algebra. Building on this concept, we investigate a fuzzy uniform structure applicable
 to PUP-algebras. We then delve into the idea of a fuzzy uniform topological PUP algebra,
 which is a PUP algebra equipped with a distinctive fuzzy topology that ensures the continuity
 of both binary operations in a fuzzy topological sense. This approach broadens the scope of
 fuzzy uniform topological PUP-algebra, leading to the derivation of numerous properties of
 fuzzy topological PUP algebras.
